responsibility: This header declares the conditional-jump expansion and pending-stack-adjust interfaces used during RTL generation. It provides APIs for saving/restoring deferred stack adjustments, emitting jump-if and jump-if-not logic from tree expressions, splitting comparisons, and generating compare-and-jump sequences directly from rtl operands, serving as the shared control-flow lowering interface for expr, stmt, expmed, and builtins code.
same_name_distinction: Declaration header in the `dojump` group: it exposes the conditional-jump and pending-stack-adjustment APIs used by expander code, whereas `gcc/dojump.cc` implements the control-flow lowering routines.
